body.name: Legacy scalar Airy tube
body.construction: The scalar Airy tube is the restriction of \(\mathrm{def:explicit\text{-}three\text{-}arm\text{-}airy\text{-}tube}\) obtained by fixing \(\zeta=0\) before mixing.  Thus it draws \(X^\dagger\) with density \(w_k^\dagger\), draws \(H^\dagger\) with density \(\rho_\varepsilon\), uses \(p_{n,x,h,0}^{\dagger,\mathrm A}\), then draws the response-count vector and a uniform labeling.  Its schedule prior is denoted \(\nu_{n,k,\varepsilon}^{\dagger,\mathrm A,0}\).  This definition is retained only to state the proved zero-face diagnostic for the superseded scalar architecture.
